messages.subject: Bug in where
parts:
Hello,

I have used the below query from the Auto data set in the ISLR library.

sqldf("select a.mpg,count(distinct a.name) from Auto2 a join Auto b on a.cylinders = b.cylinders where a.cylinders=6 and b.name=='buick century limited' group by a.mpg order by 2 desc")


It should not have any cars other than Buick. Unless I add the condition on data frame a, it enforces the condition only on b. This is not the way it works in SQL.

Thoughts?

Thanks.

On Tuesday, October 28, 2014 4:26:27 PM UTC-4, sures...@gmail.com wrote:
Hello,

I have used the below query from the Auto data set in the ISLR library.

sqldf("select a.mpg,count(distinct a.name) from Auto2 a  join Auto b on a.cylinders = b.cylinders where a.cylinders=6  and b.name=='buick century limited' group by a.mpg order by 2 desc")


It should not have any cars other than Buick. Unless I add the condition on data frame a, it enforces the condition only on b. This is not the way it works in SQL.

Thoughts?

1, There is no Auto2 in ISLR.  

2. If by Auto2 you meant Auto then since the join is only on cylinders and not on cylinders and name the joined table will contain names other than buick.
